dedupe_keys.name: ndw national road traffic data portal nationaal dataportaal wegverkeer netherlands

description: NDW is the Dutch government organisation for mobility data: it receives traffic data from suppliers, builds traffic information products and delivers them to users. Its open data portal lists real-time files that are refreshed every few minutes, including travel times, speeds and intensities at measurement sites, the measurement site table as a shapefile, matrix signal and route information panel states, road works and event plans, bridge openings, temporary closures and speed limits, truck parking status, emission zones, charging point locations and tariffs, and traffic signs, plus historic data through the Dexter service and bicycle counts. It also manages the national road database (NWB) and road attributes (WKD). Coverage is national (Netherlands). Files are free to download without registration, mostly as DATEX II XML, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefiles, and several APIs are documented on docs.ndw.nu; no licence is stated on the portal. Caveats: from 9 February 2027 the DATEX II v2.3 traffic files are replaced by v3 profiles, and documentation is mainly in Dutch. The data support traffic flow calibration, disruption and incident studies and digital twins of the road network. They complement the Nationaal Wegenbestand and the NDOV public transport data catalogued here.
